steps.content: You're reassured by what you see once you've entered the Drifter Camp. The place is still bustling like before. After all, things can't possibly get worse than how they once were at that time.

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: Inner Bay roasted tofu! Authentic Inner Bay roasted tofu! The best you can have!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Wow... It's so good... Just like Grandma's cooking...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: According to Sunsink City's sorcery texts, you are what you eat. I think eating some local food will help me get acclimated to DisCity sooner.
Yanyan stuffs the tofu into her mouth while opening her little purse, taking out a few copper coins and placing them on the stall.
The stall owner seems confused by the coins in front of her, unsure of what kind of currency she's looking at. But upon spotting you behind Yanyan, she seems to understand something.

steps.speaker: Stall Owner
steps.content: Darling, you're too skinny! Here, have a few more skewers. They're on the house!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Thank you, ma'am! Mm... No, we're here for serious business!
The girl seems to recall something after nodding, so she quickly shakes her head again and wipes her mouth, catching up with you quickly.
She's pretty determined. The girl's got more self-control than a certain grey mouse who can't move a step the moment she sees food.
As you weave through the crowd in the Drifter Camp, you suddenly hear a familiar voice.
...You don't look quite well. Want a check-up?
Of course, of course. Here we provide a unique traditional therapy that can relieve fatigue and relax the body.
The man speaks while twisting himself into a bizarre posture.

It's Greta, the barefoot doctor of the Drifter Camp. He's even given you a bottle of essence oil, but you've since stowed that funky-smelling stuff away in the deepest part of your office cabinet and never used it once.
You step forward to greet him and ask for information, but Yanyan beats you to him.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ah? Were you performing the ritual dance just now, sir? You didn't do one pose correctly. It might anger the deities and weaken the blessings.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Huh...? What are you talking about?
Greta stares at Yanyan in shock as the girl suddenly emerges before him, striking similar dramatic poses.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: See? That's how you should do it! I learned this move when I first became a novice seer.
Yanyan pulls out a book from her pocket and flips through a few pages quickly.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: What... what's this novisia you're talking about? I only know how to treat nausea...

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: And I was doing yoo...
Yanyan keeps babbling on about the ritual dance with unseen vehemence. This seems a very important subject to her, and even the surrounding crowd is listening intently.
You try to pull Yanyan away, but her enthusiasm is unstoppable and she's already begun posing, so you have no choice but to watch her perform the entire ritual dance.
A crowd has gradually gathered around you. People applaud from time to time, and some even toss a few coins at your feet.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Oops! What time is it now?! Oh no... Thank you, everyone.
Yanyan pulls you away hurriedly, muttering non-stop.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hmm... Gotta tend to the serious matters first.
